name: Cracker Spread
description: A simple and creamy cheese spread made with tomato soup and Kraft cheese, served with crackers.
recipeIngredient: 1 small size jar Kraft cheese spread

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together the tomato soup, butter, and Kraft cheese spread.
Heat the mixture but do not boil. Stir constantly for 5 minutes.

keywords: cheese spread, cracker dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.

_similar.keywords: cheese ball, party appetizer, easy snack

_similar.name: Shrimp Spread
_similar.description: A savory shrimp and cheddar cheese spread served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl.
Mash the shrimp with a fork until well blended.
Refrigerate before serving with crackers.

_similar.keywords: shrimp spread, seafood dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Sausage Balls
_similar.description: Crispy sausage and cheddar balls perfect for snacking or parties, made with biscuit mix and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the sausage in a frying pan until fully cooked.
Add the cheddar soup to the browned sausage and stir until well mixed.
Combine the sausage mixture with the biscuit mix and blend until a dough forms.
Form the dough into small balls (about 50 total).
Place the sausage balls on a cookie sheet and bake in a preheated 450°F oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

_similar.keywords: sausage balls, cheddar soup, biscuit mix, party snack

_similar.name: Artichoke Appetizer
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

_similar.keywords: artichoke appetizer, cheesy dip, party snack

_similar.name: Crab Dip
_similar.description: A rich and creamy crab dip made with cream cheese, crab meat, and green onions, served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Blend all ingredients together, including the juice from the crab meat, until smooth.
Serve with crackers.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, seafood dip, party appetizer
